description:
The Role
   

  

 We’re hiring a Founding AI Data Scientist to help define and build the intelligence layer at the core of Grand.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact individual contributor role with real ownership. You’ll work AI\-first by default, using modern tools to accelerate analysis, experimentation, and iteration. The goal is to leverage complex, real\-world data to make reliable, explainable, and useful decisions in practice.
   

  

 This is not a research lab role and not a demo factory. You’ll be building AI that runs in production, influences real financial outcomes, and improves continuously over time. Judgment matters as much as modelling. Knowing where AI adds value and where it doesn’t is part of the job.
   

  

 You’ll sit close to the founders, builders and creative teams, shaping how intelligence is designed, evaluated, and deployed across the platform. This is a seat at the founders’ table, helping define how AI is applied responsibly in a regulated, real\-world environment.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Design and build core AI and data systems that support decision\-making across the platform
* Work with complex, imperfect, and evolving data from multiple internal and external sources
* Develop models and signals that balance accuracy, uncertainty, and explainability
* Help define how intelligence is represented, updated, and acted upon inside the product
* Decide when to use ML, statistical methods, rules, or hybrids, and why
* Partner closely with product and engineering so AI is embedded in workflows, not bolted on
* Establish standards for evaluation, monitoring, and iteration in production
* Use modern AI tooling, including LLMs where appropriate, with a bias toward leverage over novelty
* Collaborate with regulatory and compliance teams to ensure outputs are defensible and robust
* Move fast without being reckless, understanding the cost of false confidence


 Must Have
   

  

* Strong grounding in statistics, probability, and applied machine learning
* Proven experience shipping AI or ML systems into production
* Experience working with non\-ideal data where ground truth is partial, delayed, or noisy
* Comfort making trade\-offs between precision, recall, confidence, and coverage
* Ability to reason about uncertainty and error, not just point predictions
* Clear communicator who can explain complex ideas to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong experience with Python and modern ML tooling
* Practical experience working with LLMs or advanced AI systems in real applications
* Bias toward building decision\-support systems, not opaque black boxes
* High intellectual honesty and strong technical judgment


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience building data science models or AI systems in fintech environments
* Exposure to credit, underwriting, or risk decisioning in real\-world settings
* Experience operating in regulated or high\-stakes domains
* Background working in early\-stage or zero\-to\-one products
* Familiarity with data platforms, feature pipelines, or model monitoring
* Experience designing systems that evolve over time, not static models


 Salary and Benefits
   

  

* Excellent Salary: Competitive and reflective of the responsibilities of a founding role
* Equity Options: Meaningful ownership in a long\-term company
* Hybrid Work: At least 3 days in our London or Dublin office
* Extended Remote Work on Request: Outcomes matter more than optics
* Builders, Not Tourists: Work with people who care deeply about getting things right


 Who You Are
   

  

 You’re a builder with a scientist’s discipline. You’re excited by messy reality, not pristine datasets. You’re sceptical of hype and careful about claims.
   

  

 You think in systems, not models in isolation. You understand that data reflects behaviour, incentives, and change over time. You design AI that improves gradually and fails gracefully.
   

  

 You’ve seen what breaks when models leave the lab, and you design accordingly. You take responsibility for the impact of your work.
   

  

 You prioritise trust, credibility, and long\-term impact over clever tricks. You value correctness, clarity, and humility over novelty.
   

  

 You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy hard problems with no obvious solution, and take pride in building AI that earns its place.
   

  

 You’re based in Dublin or in close commuting distance (or ready to be), and ready to help build something genuinely new.
   

  

**If this sounds like you, let’s talk.**

title: Data Scientist (GenAI & Agentic Systems)
description:
S vyše 2,7 mil. zákazníkov sme najväčším mobilným operátorom na Slovensku a lídrom v poskytovaní telekomunikačných služieb. V minulosti sme ako prví predstavili prelomové inovácie na trhu \- mobil za korunu, nekonečné hovory, či 24\-hodinovú zákaznícku linku a plánujeme v tom pokračovať.
   

  

 V prvom rade sme však starostlivý, zodpovedný a ľudský zamestnávateľ, a preto hľadáme rovnakých ľudí do nášho tímu. U nás budete od prvého dňa plnohodnotnou súčasťou firmy a našej komunity. Záleží nám na spoločnosti, v ktorej pôsobíme, vnímame svoju zodpovednosť voči nej, a preto sa angažujeme vo verejnoprospešných aktivitách. Pomáhame nášmu okoliu cez Nadáciu Orange, podporujeme mimovládne organizácie a tiež aktívnych jednotlivcov. Prostredníctvom týchto aktivít sa snažíme meniť svet na lepšie miesto pre všetkých.
   

  

 Záleží nám na tom, aby sa u nás každý cítil dobre. Veríme, že zamestnanie nie je len o hodnote, ktorú prinášate firme Vy, no i o tej, ktorú prináša firma Vám. Váš rozvoj je pre nás rovnako dôležitý ako pre Vás, preto Vás v ňom budeme podporovať.
   

  

 Sme hrdí na to, že sme starostlivý a zodpovedný zamestnávateľ. Pokiaľ Vás naša pozícia zaujala a zdieľate s nami rovnaké hodnoty, budeme sa tešiť na Váš životopis
   

  

 Hľadáme odborníka, ktorý nezostane len pri trénovaní modelov, ale posunie naše AI riešenia o úroveň vyššie. Pridáj sa k tímu v momente, keď štartujeme nový strategický projekt vývoja RAG chatbotov a autonómnych agentických systémov.
   

  

 Nebudeš len „analyzovať dáta“. Budeš architektom inteligentných systémov na Google Cloud Platform (GCP), ktoré budú reálne komunikovať, rozhodovať sa a vykonávať akcie. Tvojou úlohou bude prepojiť svet klasického Data Science s najnovšími trendmi v Generative AI.
   

  

**Čo bude tvojou náplňou práce?**
* GenAI \& Agentic Systems Development: Dizajnovať a implementovať pokročilé RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) aplikácie a agentické systémy, ktoré dokážu autonómne riešiť úlohy.
* Orchestrácia LLM: Využívať frameworky ako LangChain a LangGraph na stavbu komplexných tokov (flows), kde AI nielen odpovedá, ale aj koná (volá API, hľadá v databázach, spracováva dokumenty).
* Production\-Grade AI: Nasadzovať tieto riešenia do produkcie v prostredí GCP (Vertex AI), monitorovať ich výkon cez LangSmith a optimalizovať ich presnosť a cenu (token usage).
* Core Data Science: Stále budeš potrebovať silný základ – príprava dát, tvorba embeddingov, práca s vektorovými databázami a klasické ML modely tam, kde LLM nie je efektívne.
* Spolupráca: Byť technickým lídrom v diskusiách o tom, ako využiť AI na automatizáciu interných procesov a zlepšenie zákazníckej skúsenosti.


 Nehľadáme len teoretika, ale „buildera“ – niekoho, kto rád stavia funkčné riešenia.
   

  

**Technické zručnosti: Must\-have skills**
* Data Science \& ML Background: Štatistika a matematika sú tvojou silnou stránkou. Knižnice pandas a numpy ovládaš na expertnej úrovni – nepíšeš len funkčný kód, ale optimalizované a vektorizované riešenia pre veľké objemy dát. Princípy strojového učenia (regresia, klasifikácia, clustering) a validácie modelov ovládaš do hĺbky.
* Python Master: Pokročilá znalosť Pythonu je nutnosť. Musíš vedieť písať čistý, modulárny a otestovaný kód. (OOP, type hinting, async).
* SQL \& Dáta: Vieš si nielen vytiahnuť dáta, ale aj navrhnúť efektívne query a pipelines pre ich spracovanie.
* Analytické myslenie: Vieš rozložiť komplexný biznis problém na technické riešenie a rozhodnúť, kedy použiť klasické ML a kedy GenAI.


**Výhodou: Čo ťa dostane na pohovor prednostne :**
* GenAI Stack: Máš praktickú skúsenosť s LangChain alebo LangGraph. Vieš, čo je to chain, agent, tool calling alebo memory.

 As a

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Everything happens somewhere \- which is why spatial analytics is fundamental to companies trying to understand the “where” and the “why” of their business. CARTO is the world's leading cloud\-native spatial analysis
platform, built to break down the silos of traditional GIS. Trusted by data scientists, analysts, and developers from global brands such as IKEA, Coca\-Cola, T\-Mobile, Swiss Re, and AXA, CARTO enables organizations to run scalable spatial analysis directly on their cloud data warehouse. Providing insights for critical use cases like site selection, catastrophe modeling, network planning, and supply chain optimization.  

Built by a diverse team of over 150 people across the US, APAC, and Europe, CARTO's cloud\-native Agentic GIS platform provides a modern, future\-proof alternative to legacy GIS. Offering a powerful suite of tools for visualization, analytics, and application development, our platform is redefining how companies work with location data. CARTO (backed by Insight Partners, Accel Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and Earlybird Ventures, among others) is fundamentally changing the way location data is analyzed, making it an integrated and accessible part of modern business intelligence.  

To continue this growth, our CARTO Infrastructure team is looking for an enthusiastic SRE Engineer to help us scale up our groundbreaking CARTO Cloud\-Native product.  

In CARTO we know that the use of AI fosters innovation and delivers a superior product to users, that’s why we integrate cutting\-edge AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle to enhance design, build, test, deploy, and maintain our spatial analytics platform.  

If you love to be in contact with top engineers around the world in geospatial, this is your place!  

This is a remote\-first role, open to candidates based anywhere **in Spain**. We have offices in Madrid and Seville if you prefer to work in person or want a place to collaborate occasionally, but there's no expectation to use them.  

You will


* Automate Everything: Design and operate reliable platform infrastructures using Kubernetes and Serverless technologies.
* Code Your Infrastructure: Use Terraform to develop "Infrastructure as Code," ensuring high availability and robust testing.
* Innovate with AI: Integrate AI tools into your daily workflow and orchestrate AI agents to work in an agentic way.
* Evolve the Stack: Develop custom tools to enhance internal services and client experiences.
* Deep Observability: Keep our systems transparent using Google Cloud monitoring and Honeycomb.
* Refine the Product: Manage HELM charts to ensure our Self\-Hosted product remains robust across GKE, AKS, and EKS.
* Support System Stability: Participate in an optional on\-call rotation to maintain our high\-availability standards.
You are


* Cloud Master: You have deep expertise in GCP (though other clouds are a plus) and a mastery of Terraform.
* Container Guru: Kubernetes, Docker, and HELM are your native languages.
* OS Expert: You have a deep understanding of Linux internals, from systemd to signals.
* Data Fluent: You have a solid grasp of PostgreSQL and BigQuery.
* Security Focused: You naturally apply security best practices to every layer of the stack.

  

  

**We will be fascinated if …**
* You are a data powerhouse. You have a deep understanding of PostgreSQL and are comfortable navigating the modern data stack, including BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, or Snowflake.
* You have a polyglot mindset. You don't just write scripts; you can contribute to our codebase in any of the languages we use, whether it’s Typescript, Python, or Bash.
* You understand global performance. You have hands\-on experience managing CDNs and optimizing content delivery to ensure a seamless experience for users worldwide.
* You are a transformation veteran. You have battle\-tested experience leading the migration from legacy infrastructure to a high\-performance, cloud\-native ecosystem.
* You are ahead of the AI curve. You know how to go beyond basic automation by orchestrating AI agents to work in an agentic way, building self\-evolving workflows that push the boundaries of traditional SRE.
* You have spatial DNA. You have a background in GIS or a genuine fascination with maps and the unique challenges of handling geospatial data at scale.
We offer


* Compensation based on experience, discussed transparently during the process, plus an annual bonus of up to 10% based on company objectives
* Contribute to a platform used by top companies around the world. Your work will have a direct impact on our users and clients
* Access to our Employee Stock Options Plan
* Private Medical Insurance
* Flexible compensation
* Education stipend
* Remote work stipend
* English classes
About CARTO


We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.
